integrity: Original algebraic proof and executable exact-arithmetic checks accompany this package. No independent mathematical review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proved theorem is restricted to unit-conductance K_{p,q} with integers p>=q>=3 and two distinct failed links. The matching-deletion (disjoint) Kirchhoff-index formula is known; the new claim is its sharp ordering against both incident motifs, positive pairwise interactions, and the imbalance transition. An inaccessible related 2020 extremal-diameter article and incomplete indexing remain originality risks.
title: A sharp cubic-imbalance reversal in two-link resistance vulnerability of complete bipartite networks
